data.file_warnings: *** PAGE OFFSET FOR THIS WHOLE HOUSE: PNG = printed page + 2. *** หน้า01 is the cover and หน้า02 is this contents page, neither of which carries a printed page number; printed page 1 is PNG 03. VERIFIED by opening PNG 34 and finding S-01 with the printed page number 32 in its footer, exactly as this index states. Every maps_to_png value in this file is derived with that +2 offset -- it is NOT printed on the sheet., 68 drawing sheets in five disciplines (A-01..A-31, S-01..S-17, SN-01..SN-10, EE-01..EE-06, M-01..M-04), then two parallel BOQ sets and a planning-regulations appendix. 108 PNG pages in total., TWO PARALLEL BOQ SETS, exactly as in houses 04 and 05: one costed for spread footings (printed 69, PNG 71) and one for pile footings (printed 86, PNG 88). They are alternative pricings of the same building, not sequential parts -- do not merge them., This house belongs to a DIFFERENT SERIES from house 06: 'แบบบ้านสานฝัน ของขวัญปีใหม่' (2562/2019) rather than 'ไทยช่วยไทย' (2546/2003). Different drawing-number format (S 62047), different sheet-code scheme (EE not E, M present), and a universal-design brief (บ้านอารยสถาปัตย์ -- accessible housing for the elderly and disabled).

data.file_warnings: *** THE ARCHITECTURAL SET HAS ITS OWN DRAWING NUMBER: AR 61142, not the structural set's S 62047. *** Both are dated ม.ค. 2562 and belong to the same house, but they are separately numbered submissions. Do not treat the drawing number as a project id., This sheet is three panels in one: the architectural sheet index (A-01..A-31), the material schedule keyed by the numbers that appear in room tags, and the symbol legend for the whole set., THE INDEX CONFIRMS THE +2 PAGE OFFSET for the architectural set too -- A-01 is printed page 1 and is PNG 03. maps_to_png is derived on each entry, not printed., MATERIAL NUMBERS ARE THE KEY TO THE FLOOR PLANS. Room tags on A-05/A-06 carry a floor-finish number, a level and a ceiling number, all of which resolve against the lists here: floors 1-5, walls 1-2, ceilings 1-5. A plan tag reading '1 +0.00 1' means vinyl tile, datum level, standard gypsum ceiling., FIRST MENTION OF THE ROOF COVERING IN THE WHOLE SET: the insulation note says the roof is มุงด้วยกระเบื้องลอนคู่ (double-corrugated tile). S-05 and S-06 gave only the steel frame beneath it., The insulation requirement is a MINIMUM with two carve-outs: foil-wrapped glass wool not less than 2" over ceilings generally, but NOT over bathrooms and NOT outside the building., Skirting is specified only for floor type 1 (vinyl tile) and ceiling trim only for ceiling types 1-4. Those restrictions are printed in the entries themselves and are kept in the notes rather than being generalised.

data.file_warnings: The written specification for the whole architectural package. Two columns of dense Thai prose organised as 1. วัตถุประสงค์, 2.1 การวางผังและระดับ, 2.2 งานสถาปัตยกรรม (sub-sections ก through ช), then 2.3 structure, 2.4 sanitary, 2.5 electrical -- the last three of which just point at the engineering drawings., *** INSULATION THICKNESS CONTRADICTS A-01. *** A-01's หมายเหตุ calls for foil-wrapped glass wool 'หนาไม่น้อยกว่า 2"' over the ceiling; this sheet says 'หนาไม่น้อยกว่า 3"' in TWO places (งานฝ้าเพดาน and งานหลังคา). Both are minima, so 3" satisfies both, but the two sheets do not agree and neither is marked as superseding the other. Recorded as printed on each sheet; flagged here., The one hard, buildable rule on this sheet that is not a product reference is the masonry tie-in: RB6 dowels at not more than 40 cm, projecting 25 cm and embedded 10 cm into the RC; and an RC เอ็น/ทับหลัง the full wall thickness x 10 cm wide, reinforced 2-RB6 with RB6 ties at 0.20 m, wherever a wall exceeds 2 m high or 3 m long. Those are quantities a take-off can actually use., EIGHT มอก. STANDARDS ARE CITED. They are also collected into a single standards_reference element so a consumer does not have to re-scan the prose., A BLANKET SUBSTITUTION CLAUSE closes the material sections: 'วัสดุต่างๆดังกล่าวข้างต้น สามารถเปลี่ยนแปลงได้ตามความเหมาะสมและวัตถุประสงค์ของผู้ว่าจ้าง'. Every named product on this sheet is therefore indicative., Named products appear in only three places -- ceiling insulation (STAYCOOL, สยามไมโครไฟเบอร์) and granite wall tile (SCG, KENZAI, BEZEN, VIZENZA). Everything else is specified by standard or by dimension., งานหลังคา NAMES TWO ALTERNATIVE COVERINGS -- fibre-cement double-corrugated tile (มอก.1407-2540) OR profiled metal sheet (มอก.1128-2535). A-01's note assumed the tile. Which one is built is not decided on either sheet., Prose is transcribed condensed but faithful: each bullet is one printed dash-item. Nothing has been paraphrased into English.

data.file_warnings: UNIVERSAL-DESIGN GUIDANCE SHEET -- the design brief behind the whole บ้านอารยสถาปัตย์ series, and unusually for a drawing sheet it is almost entirely NUMERIC criteria. Every dimensional rule has been pulled out into its own design_criterion element with the figure in a typed field as well as in printed_as, because these numbers are checkable against the plans on A-05/A-06 and the details on A-16..A-28., THE HARD NUMBERS, collected: ramp 1:12; front door 90-150 cm wide; internal doors at least 90 cm clear; chair/bed height 40-45 cm; window sill about 45 cm; kitchen counter 80 cm; wall units 150-168 cm; counter socket 90 cm; general sockets at least 45 cm; switches not more than 90 cm; bed at least 180 cm long with 150 cm clear one side and 90 cm on the other sides, clear on 3 sides; bed 40 cm high; grab rail 4 cm diameter, 80 cm above a ramp, at least 5 cm off the wall., *** GRAB-RAIL DIAMETER IS GIVEN TWICE AND DOES NOT AGREE: the ห้องน้ำ paragraph says 3-4 ซม. and the ราวจับ paragraph says 4 ซม. *** Both are recorded as printed. 4 cm satisfies both, but the sheet contradicts itself., TWO PROHIBITIONS ARE STATED, not just preferences: no threshold at the entrance ('ไม่ควรมีธรณีประตู') and NO self-closing devices on doors ('ห้ามติดตั้งอุปกรณ์ชนิดที่บังคับให้บานประตูปิดได้เอง'). The second uses ห้าม (forbidden), the strongest wording on the sheet., THE SHEET IDENTIFIES WHICH DESIGN THIS IS: the series has three designs -- two single-storey and one two-storey -- and this drawing set is the two-storey one, briefed as ground floor for the elderly / mobility-impaired and upper floor for other occupants. That explains the ST-1/ST-2 stair arrangement and the ground-floor bathroom layout., The guidance is sourced from four named bodies, led by Chulalongkorn's architecture faculty research unit on environments for the elderly. Recorded as a reference_list.

data.file_warnings: SITE PLAN, AND THE SHEET SAYS IT IS ONLY AN EXAMPLE: 'ผังบริเวณนี้เป็นเพียงตัวอย่างเพื่อประมาณราคาค่าก่อสร้าง ส่วนประกอบอาคารเท่านั้น ส่วนรายละเอียดของสถานที่จริงให้กำหนดรายละเอียดขณะก่อสร้าง'. Everything outside the building footprint is indicative and settled on site., *** THE MINIMUM PLOT IS STATED AS A FORMULA, NOT A FIXED SIZE. *** 17.20 x 16.20 m is the plot you get at the minimum setbacks A = 2.10 m (three sides) and B = 3.10 m (the front), both printed as 'ระยะปรับตามที่ดิน แต่ขนาดไม่น้อยกว่า...'. Both chains close exactly on those minima: 2.10 + 13.00 + 2.10 = 17.20, and 2.10 + 11.00 + 3.10 = 16.20 where the printed 1.60 + 1.50 is B split in two. That boundary is still not dimensioned on this sheet either -- it is read off the ridge position, so the main mass's south edge is still approximate., ONLY THREE SECTION MARKS APPEAR HERE (A-A, B-B, C-C). data.file_warnings: *** THIS IS A GENERIC NATIONAL/BANGKOK REGULATORY APPENDIX, NOT A PROJECT-SPECIFIC DRAWING. *** It is the same ten-clause site-plan permit reference (ผังบริเวณ, บ่อเกรอะ, ทางระบายน้ำ, ที่ว่างปราศจากสิ่งปกคลุม, แนวร่น, ความสูงอาคาร, ระยะห่างเขตที่ดิน x2, อาคารใกล้กันในที่ดินเดียวกัน, การขออนุญาตในเขตตำบล) that presumably appears at the back of every house in this กรมโยธาธิการ 'บ้านสานฝัน' series (PNG 107 confirms this book is one of three standard designs), plus a Bangkok-specific addendum., *** CLAUSE 5.1's ROAD-SETBACK FORMULA IS THE REGULATORY BASIS FOR A-04's SITE-PLAN SETBACKS A/B, WHICH A-04 EXPLICITLY LEAVES ADJUSTABLE ('ปรับได้ตามสภาพจริง'). *** Reading them together: A-04 gives a worked example at the minimum road width tier, and this appendix is the general rule a real site would be checked against., *** THIS HOUSE'S FLOOR AREA EXCEEDS CLAUSE 10's 150 ตร.ม. EXEMPTION THRESHOLD, so the simplified rural (อบต.) permit path this clause describes does NOT apply -- full building-control permitting is required wherever this design is actually built., The open-space clause (4) repeats the same 30/100 ratio already cited on this book's ground-floor set-out sheet, confirming the two references agree., None of these clauses were checked against this specific house's actual dimensions (no real site exists -- A-06 states the site plan is illustrative only, 'เพื่อประมาณราคา'), so this file is a reference table only, not a compliance finding.

data.file_warnings: *** THIS PAGE NAMES THE OVERARCHING PUBLIC PROGRAM, 'บ้านสานฝัน ของขวัญปีใหม่ คนไทยมีความสุข' (Dream House, New Year Gift, Thai People's Happiness) -- run by กรมโยธาธิการและผังเมือง, กระทรวงมหาดไทย. *** 'บ้านอารยสถาปัตย์ 3', this specific house's name in every BOQ title block, is one design produced under that program (PNG 107 shows there are three: 1, 2 and 3)., Four credited groups: ที่ปรึกษา (7 advisors, department leadership), คณะทำงานกำกับดูแล (10-person oversight committee), คณะทำงานออกแบบและประมาณราคา split into two design bureaus (Architecture, 9 people; Structural/Systems Engineering, 6 people), and คณะทำงานประสานงาน split into two coordination offices (กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง -- the BOQ-pricing office named on every ปร.4 sheet in this book, 10 people; and กองเผยแพร่และประชาสัมพันธ์, publicity, 3 people)., Proper names are transcribed as best legible at this scan resolution and flagged proper_names_ocr_uncertain -- Thai given names with unusual spellings are the likeliest source of transcription error on this page, not a load-bearing technical fact., *** PUBLICATION DATE: 1st printing, June 2019 (มิถุนายน 2562), printed by บริษัท แอคทีฟ 888 จำกัด. *** This is the only date in the whole book that is not a per-sheet drawing date -- every drawing title block instead says ม.ค. 2562 (January 2019), so the drawing set was complete about five months before this printed compilation.

data.file_warnings: *** THIS PAGE GIVES OFFICIAL DEPARTMENT TOTAL PRICES FOR ALL THREE STANDARD HOUSE DESIGNS, INCLUDING THIS BOOK'S HOUSE, UNDER BOTH FOUNDATION TYPES -- SOMETHING NO OTHER PAGE IN THE 108-PAGE BOOK STATES. *** Every ปร.4 BOQ sheet in this book (PNG 71-104) has every price cell blank by design (an unpriced quantity schedule for the estimator to fill in); this catalog page is the only place a finished total appears: บ้านอารยสถาปัตย์ 3 = 3,000,000 บาท on ฐานรากเข็มตอก (driven pile) or 2,745,000 บาท on ฐานรากแผ่ (spread footing)., *** THESE TOTALS CANNOT BE DERIVED FROM THIS BOOK'S BOQ SHEETS -- they almost certainly come from the department's own internal unit-price database (unrelated to this raw-JSON extraction), not from summing this book's blank ปร.4 forms. Treat them as an independent department-published reference figure, not as ground truth this extraction can reproduce or verify quantity-by-quantity., *** THE PILE-FOUNDATION PRICE IS HIGHER THAN THE SPREAD-FOOTING PRICE FOR ALL THREE DESIGNS (by roughly 100,000-255,000 บาท), consistent with driven piles being the more expensive foundation solution -- but note this book's own structural drawings (S-02..S-10) draw ONLY the pile-foundation variant, so in practice a build from this specific drawing set would use the higher-priced ฐานรากเข็มตอก figure, not a free choice between the two., Confirms the three-design catalog: design 1 (160 ตร.ม., 1 storey, cheapest), design 2 (150 ตร.ม., 1 storey, smaller than design 1 but MORE expensive -- a genuine non-monotonic price-vs-area relationship, most likely reflecting a more complex roof form, not a transcription error), design 3 (210 ตร.ม., 2 storeys, this book, most expensive)., *** PNG 108 (the book's final page) is a full-colour duplicate of this same catalog spread with no additional data -- a decorative back cover. *** It was NOT extracted into its own file, following the same precedent already set for PNG 01 (the book's front cover), which was also skipped as containing no unique technical or quantitative content., No printed page number is visible on this page (unlike every numbered sheet elsewhere in the book), consistent with it being outer cover matter rather than a numbered content page.

The single-storey wing's ring beam sits only 0.40 m above the second-floor line, which is why the wing roof tucks under the main roof on the elevation., Roof pitch 25° is confirmed here for a third time (A-06, A-07, A-08 all agree) and the 1.20 m eaves oversail for a third time as well., TWO SMALL FACADE ELEMENTS ARE SPECIFIED HERE AND NOWHERE ELSE: a 100 x 100 mm rendered cornice band ('บัวปูนปั้น ฉาบปูนเรียบ ทาสี สูง 10 ซม หนา 10 ซม') and 10 x 10 mm scored grooves ('แนวเซาะร่อง กว้าง 1 ซม ลึก 1 ซม') used as horizontal banding. And 1.225 + 2.475 + 1.30 = 5.00 m, exactly the grid D-C bay., A 0.15 m RISER WITH A 0.275 m TREAD IS DELIBERATELY SHALLOW -- this is the accessible-housing brief from A-03 showing up in the geometry. A conventional Thai house stair would be nearer 0.175-0.20 m., The 2.40 m stairwell splits as 0.20 / 0.90 / 0.225 / 0.90 -- two 0.90 m flights with a 0.225 m gap. That 2.40 is the same figure as the 2.40 / 0.20 / 2.40 sub-chain on the floor plans and on structural sheet S-04, so architecture and structure agree on the well., Handrail height 0.90 m is dimensioned three times. Note this is the STAIR rail; A-03 sets the RAMP rail at 0.80 m above the ramp, a different figure for a different place., Two enlargements are called out from here, ดูขยาย 1 and ดูขยาย 2, both on A-17., Step numbering differs between the two plans -- 1 to 15 on the ground-floor plan (cut at the usual 1.2 m plan height) and 1 to 20 on the upper one. That is the STAIR figure; A-03 sets the RAMP rail at 0.80 m above the ramp surface. Two different heights for two different places -- do not merge them., The column-base enlargement is a 0.50 x 0.50 encasement round the 0.20 x 0.20 RC column, set 0.10 off centre, with a 0.62 m shaft and a 0.05 m cap. The entrance steps at +0.10 / +0.25 / +0.38 run past it, matching the site plan and A-05., *** TWO DIFFERENT GROOVES EXIST IN THIS SET AND THEY ARE EASY TO CONFUSE: *** the facade banding on A-08/A-09 is 'แนวเซาะร่อง กว้าง 1 ซม ลึก 1 ซม', while the pier here is 'เซาะร่องกว้าง 5 ซม ลึก 1.5 ซม' -- five times wider. data.view_title: แบบขยายประตู  1:50
data.file_warnings: *** THE DOOR SCHEDULE, AND IT SETTLES HALF THE OPENING-MARK AMBIGUITY CARRIED SINCE A-05. *** There are exactly FIVE door marks, 1 to 5. Any circled mark 6 seen on the plans and elevations therefore CANNOT be a door -- it must be a window. A-23 should confirm., EVERY DOOR IS 2.05 M HIGH without exception. Widths are 3.10 / 0.80 / 1.10 / 1.10 / 0.90., *** DOOR 2 IS 0.80 M WIDE, BELOW THE 0.90 M CLEAR WIDTH THE A-03 UNIVERSAL-DESIGN BRIEF SETS ('มีขนาดกว้างอย่างน้อย 90 ซม'). *** It serves the upper-floor bathroom, which is the storey the brief itself says is for occupants without mobility problems -- so it is probably deliberate, but the drawing does not say so. Flagged here rather than silently accepted., MATERIALS SPLIT CLEANLY: door 1 is white powder-coated ALUMINIUM with 6 mm green tinted glass; doors 2-5 are all UPVC. That matches A-02, which specifies both systems., FOUR OF THE FIVE DOORS SLIDE. Only door 5 is a swing leaf, and it is the only one given the lever handle ('มือจับชนิดก้านโยก') that A-02 and A-03 require. The sliders get 'ชุดรางเลื่อนพร้อมอุปกรณ์ล็อคและมือจับสแตนเลส มาตรฐานครบชุด'. A-03's preference for sliding doors is clearly followed., A painted hardwood pelmet 3/4"x4" boxes the sliding track on doors 2, 3 and 4 but not on the aluminium door 1 -- a small item easy to miss in a take-off., The ลูกฟัก (panel/glazing) row is left BLANK for doors 2, 4 and 5. That is as printed; no glazing is specified for them., Level tags show where each door is used: doors 1 and 5 on both floors (+0.40 and +3.40), doors 3 and 4 on the ground floor only, door 2 upstairs only.

data.file_warnings: *** THE WINDOW SCHEDULE, AND WITH A-22 IT FULLY RESOLVES THE OPENING-MARK AMBIGUITY CARRIED SINCE A-05. *** Doors are numbered 1-5 (A-22) and windows 1-6 (here). So a mark 6 anywhere on the plans or elevations is necessarily a WINDOW, and marks 1-5 are ambiguous by number alone -- they must be read from the symbol shape (circle = door, pentagon = window per A-01). The opening_mark_set entries on A-05, A-06 and the elevations can now be narrowed on that basis., *** THE 0.45 M SILL ON WINDOWS 1, 2 AND 3 IS THE A-03 BRIEF MADE REAL. *** A-03 asks for 'ระดับหน้าต่างสูงจากพื้นประมาณ 45 ซม เพื่อให้สามารถเห็นทัศนียภาพภายนอก' -- a sill low enough to see out of while seated. Windows 1-3 have exactly that, achieved with a 0.40 m fixed light below the opening sash. Window 4 has no lower light and sits at 0.85 m; windows 5 and 6 are high-level., EVERY WINDOW IS ALUMINIUM: white powder-coated frame and sash with 6 mm green tinted glass, matching door 1 and มอก. 284-2530. Not one UPVC window in the set, although four of the five doors are UPVC., Heads line up at 2.05 m on windows 1-5, the same head height as every door. Only window 6 breaks it., WINDOW 6 IS THE ODD ONE OUT IN EVERY WAY: 3.55 m tall, in two 0.80 m panels, and its level is given as 'ระดับพื้นชานพัก' (the stair landing) rather than as a number, because it spans between floors in the stairwell. It is the mark 6 seen on the plans., Three hardware sets are used and each matches its opening type -- sliding, casement and awning -- all 'อลูมิเนียมครบชุด'.

data.file_warnings: *** THE ACCESSIBLE BATHROOM, AND THE ONE PLACE IN THE SET WHERE THE WHEELCHAIR IS DRAWN AND DIMENSIONED. *** A dashed 1.50 m circle labelled 'เส้นประแสดงรัศมีหมุนรถเข็น ø1.50m.' occupies the middle of the room, with a wheelchair drawn beside grab rail H4. A-03 states the principle but never this number., The 0.02 m drop from the โถง (+0.40) into the bathroom (+0.38) is handled with a 10 cm bevel running the full door width -- 'ลาดเอียง กว้าง 10 ซม ยาวตลอด' -- rather than a threshold, exactly as A-03 demands ('ไม่ควรมีธรณีประตู')., FOUR MARKS H, H2, H3, H4 ARE USED IN THIS ONE ROOM AND NONE IS DEFINED HERE -- RESOLVED LATER BY A-29 (PNG 31), WHICH OVERTURNED THE READING TAKEN ON THIS SHEET. The natural reading, that all four are grab rails, is wrong: only H2 and H3 are (A-26 details them). H is a chrome TOWEL RAIL at 1.50 m, and H4 is a movable height-adjustable SHOWER SEAT which A-29 marks 'เจ้าของจัดหาเอง' -- owner-supplied, outside the contract. That is why the object drawn beside the wheelchair here is chair-shaped, and why A-26 details H1/H2/H3 but never H4., SEVERAL FIXTURE MARKS ARE LEFT UNEXPANDED on this sheet -- SP, K, S, PH -- and A-29 (PNG 31) settles all four. SP is a SOAP DISH ('ที่วางสบู่'), which the reading taken here got WRONG (it guessed a water outlet from the wall position). K is a lever floor-washing tap, S a chrome bidet spray and PH a wall-mounted paper holder -- those three were read correctly., The room is 2.30 x 3.40 m internally with wall finish 2 (ceramic tile) tagged all round, floor 2 and ceiling 2 -- the only 2/2/2 room in the house., The fixture set-out is fully dimensioned in the letter direction (0.40 / 0.80 / 0.80 / 0.80 / 0.50 / 0.50 = 3.40), so every fixture position is recoverable., Sections A and B are cut from here to A-25.

data.file_warnings: *** THIS SHEET DEFINES THE GRAB-RAIL MARKS USED IN THE BATHROOMS -- H1, H2 and H3 -- which A-24 and A-25 use without explaining. *** H1 is the adjustable shower-head slide rail (1.22-1.80 m), H2 an L-shaped shower grab rail (0.42 m, top at 0.80 m), H3 a 1.20 m vertical shower grab rail. Two further rails are detailed without an H mark: the folding pair at the basin and the fixed-plus-folding pair at the WC., *** THE MARK H4, WHICH A-24 SHOWS AT THE SHOWER BESIDE THE DRAWN WHEELCHAIR, IS NOT DEFINED ON THIS SHEET. *** Nor is the plain H at the WC, unless it is meant to be the WC rail detailed here without a mark. Both remain open; A-29 (รายการสุขภัณฑ์) is the last place they could be defined., TWO OF THE FIVE RAILS FOLD ('ชนิดพับได้') -- at the basin and on the open side of the WC. That is what lets a wheelchair pull alongside, and it is a materially different (and more expensive) item from a fixed rail in a take-off., ALL RAILS ARE STAINLESS ø 1 1/2" with some ø 1" secondary members. A-03 asks for ø 3-4 cm; 1 1/2" is 3.8 cm, inside that range., RAIL HEIGHTS CLUSTER AT 0.80 M -- the H2 top, the basin rails and the WC rails are all at or about 0.80, with the WC also dimensioned at 0.70. That is the seated working height, distinct from the 0.90 m stair and balcony rails., The WC position is given as a RANGE, '0.26-0.30' from the wall to the centre-line, rather than a single figure -- the only ranged dimension found so far in the set. It accommodates different pan models.

The H mark is resolved there too, and the reading taken on this sheet was WRONG: H is a chrome TOWEL RAIL at 1.50 m, not a grab rail. *** So WC2 contains NO grab rail of any kind *** -- the full H1/H2/H3 set and the owner-supplied H4 shower seat are ground-floor only, which is exactly what the A-03 brief says (accessible accommodation downstairs, upper floor for occupants without mobility problems)., Sections A and B are cut from here to A-28.

data.file_warnings: *** THIS SHEET OVERTURNS THREE MARK READINGS TAKEN EARLIER IN THE SET. *** A-24, A-25 and A-27 use SP, K, S, PH, H and H4 without expanding them, and their meanings had to be guessed from position. The schedule settles them:,   1. **H IS A CHROME TOWEL RAIL** ('ราวแขวนผ้าโลหะชุบโครเมียม'), NOT a grab rail -- despite sitting among H1/H2/H3/H4 which mostly are. The earlier files recorded it as an undefined grab_rail; that reading is wrong.,   2. **H4 IS A MOVABLE HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE SHOWER SEAT** ('เก้าอี้นั่งอาบน้ำปรับระดับ ย้ายที่ได้'), NOT a rail -- and it is **OWNER-SUPPLIED, 'เจ้าของจัดหาเอง'**, so it is outside the building contract entirely. This explains two things that looked like omissions: why A-24 draws a chair-shaped object beside the wheelchair, and why A-26 details H1/H2/H3 but never H4.,   3. **SP IS A SOAP DISH** ('ที่วางสบู่'). A-24 guessed it as a water outlet from its wall position -- wrong. K is a lever floor-washing tap and S a chrome bidet spray, which the earlier guesses got roughly right., FOUR ROWS HAVE BLANK PRODUCT COLUMNS -- M, H2, H3 and (partly) H4. M is specified by size on the installation diagram instead; H2 and H3 are fabricated to the A-26 details rather than bought. Blank here means 'not a catalogue item', not 'missing data'., THREE BRANDS ARE OFFERED IN PARALLEL for every catalogue item -- SANA, COTTO and AMERICAN STANDARD -- with a specific model number in each column. They are alternatives, not a set; pricing must pick one column, not sum them. Two rows (LAV1, K) have no SANA equivalent., ONE ROW HAS NO SYMBOL AT ALL: the lever shower mixer ('ก๊อกน้ำฝักบัวอาบน้ำ ชนิดก้านโยก'). It is scheduled and priced but carries no plan mark, so it cannot be located from the bathroom drawings -- it belongs with SH., THE STOP-VALVE NOTE IS A REAL QUANTITY that appears nowhere else: a chrome-plated stop valve at EVERY supply point ('ทุกจุด')., The installation-height strip at the bottom is the single place every mounting height is fixed: LAV/LAV1 0.80, WC and S 0.50, PH 0.50, SH 1.80, K 0.80, SP 1.00, H 1.50, mirrors topping out at 2.00 with a 0.20 gap above the basin.

Key values for joining onto elements: concrete ค.3 with fc' >= 210 ksc at 28 days; ø6 and ø9 bars are ROUND SR-24 (fy >= 2400); ø12 and above are DEFORMED SD-40 / SD-40T (fy >= 4000)., The SR-24 / SD-40 split is by DIAMETER, not by element. Any element with ø6 or ø9 stirrups and ø12+ main bars therefore mixes two steel grades -- record steel_grade per bar, not per element., Foundation type is soil-dependent as in house 06, but the threshold and pile differ: here it is 6 t/m² (not 8), and the pile is a SOLID SQUARE 0.22x0.22 m at >= 3.0 t safe load, 6.00 m assumed for pricing (house 06 used a hollow hexagonal 0.15x0.15 at 1.7 t). Item 3.3 requires choosing one system throughout., Floors are PRECAST SOLID PLANK (SP) 5 cm thick with a 5 cm structural topping reinforced ø6@0.20 or WIRE MESH ø4@0.15 (fy >= 5270), designed for >= 300 kg/m² live plus finishes. This is a new element type not seen in house 06., Item 5 confirms structural steel is present (fy >= 2400, arc-welded, two coats of lead-oxide primer) -- consistent with S-15's title about fixing steel beams and rafters to RC columns., The 'ø' symbol is used on this sheet for BOTH round bars (item 2.1) and the square pile dimension (item 3.1, 'ø0.22x0.22'), where it cannot mean a diameter. data.file_warnings: ROOF-LEVEL FRAMING, ALL STRUCTURAL STEEL. Every member on this sheet is recorded with steel_section per spec §6a and none carries main_bar/stirrup. Sections come from the sheet's own หมายเหตุ block: จันทันเหล็ก C-100x50x20x2.3 มม. (4.06 กก./ม.), แปเหล็ก C-75x45x15x2.3 มม. @1.00 ม. (3.25 กก./ม.), อกไก่เหล็ก 2 C-125x50x20x3.2 มม. (6.13 กก./ม.), ตะเฆ่สันเหล็ก 2 C-100x50x20x2.3 มม. (4.06 กก./ม.), CS1 = ตั้งเหล็ก 2 C-150x75x25x3.2 มม. (8.27 กก./ม.), BS1 = คานเหล็ก 2 C-150x75x25x3.2 มม. (8.27 กก./ม.)., BS1 and CS1 are the SAME section (2 C-150x75x25x3.2, 8.27 กก./ม.) used two ways -- BS1 as a beam (คาน), CS1 as a post (ตั้ง). The mark, not the section, distinguishes them, so element_type is set from the mark., TWO DISTINCT ROOF ZONES. Over the main block (grids 1-3) the sheet draws only a BS1 beam grillage with three CS1 props and no rafters or purlins at all. Over the right wing (grid 3 to grid 4 + 1.20 m) it draws a full hipped roof -- ridge, two hips, rafters and purlins. Whatever covers the main block is therefore NOT documented on this sheet; look for it on the roof sections (S-06 onward)., ROOF GEOMETRY READ FROM THE LINE WEIGHTS, and worth re-checking: the อกไก่ leader arrows onto the SHORT thick-dashed segment at the west end, so the ridge runs from grid 3 eastward only about 1.50 m, and the two 45-degree hips run from that point out to the north-east and south-east corners. The long thick dash-dot line continuing east on the same centre-line is then the central rafter of the east hip plane, not the ridge. The 45-degree hip slope and the ridge sitting exactly at mid-depth of the roof rectangle both confirm this reading., The right-wing roof oversails 1.20 m on the north, east and south sides (1.20 printed at the top right and at the middle right); on the west it stops on grid 3 where it meets the main block. Overall framed rectangle 5.20 x 7.40 m., จันทัน SPACING IS NOT PRINTED. The dimension chain along the bottom of the roof shows an even spacing that scales to about 1.50 m; recorded as 1.50 with spacing_scaled_not_printed. Only the แป spacing (@1.00 ม.) is printed., The intermediate BS1 in the 1-2 bay between rows C and B, and the CS1 that props it, have NO locating dimension -- their position is scaled and flagged off_grid_member_no_printed_dimension., The circled 'ดูขยาย 1' at grid A-1 is captioned 'แสดงการยึดเสา ค.ส.ล.กับคานเหล็กและจันทัน' -- the sheet's own confirmation that the frame is HYBRID, RC columns below carrying a steel roof above. The enlargement itself is on S-15 (PNG 48): a 200x200x9 base plate on the column head with two Ø9 anchors 0.15 m deep, and the rafter cleated to BS1 with a 100x100x9 plate.

data.view_title: แปลนโครงหลังคา  1:100
data.file_warnings: THIS SHEET ANSWERS THE GAP LEFT BY S-05. S-05 drew a BS1 beam grillage over the main block but no rafters or purlins; the main block's actual roof structure is here -- a large hipped steel roof with a south-west wing., MEMBER SCHEDULE (from the sheet's own หมายเหตุ block): จันทันเหล็ก C-150x75x25x3.2 มม. (8.27 กก./ม.), แปเหล็ก C-100x50x20x2.3 มม. @1.00 ม. (4.06 กก./ม.), ตะเฆ่รางเหล็ก 2 C-125x65x6x8 มม. (13.40 กก./ม.), ตะเฆ่สันเหล็ก 2 C-125x65x6x8 มม. (13.40 กก./ม.), อกไก่เหล็ก 2 C-125x65x6x8 มม. (13.40 กก./ม.). All recorded with steel_section per spec §6a., NOTE THE SECTION SWAP BETWEEN S-05 AND S-06. The same member names carry DIFFERENT sections on the two sheets: here จันทัน is C-150x75x25x3.2 (8.27 กก./ม.) and แป is C-100x50x20x2.3 (4.06 กก./ม.); on S-05 จันทัน is C-100x50x20x2.3 (4.06) and แป is C-75x45x15x2.3 (3.25). This is not a contradiction -- S-06 frames the big main roof and S-05 the small right wing -- but any consumer that keys sections off the member NAME alone will get it wrong. Key off the sheet as well., ตะเฆ่ราง, ตะเฆ่สัน and อกไก่ are all the SAME section on this sheet (2 C-125x65x6x8, 13.40 กก./ม.) but are three distinct marks, so they are kept as three elements., ROOF TOPOLOGY WAS TRACED FROM LINE WEIGHTS at 1:100 and carries roof_topology_traced_from_line_weight. What is drawn: a heavy dash-dot ridge in the number direction 0.50 m north of grid C, four 45-degree hips to the corners of the main mass, a second ridge in the letter direction over the south-west wing with two more hips, and one valley between the two masses. The hip/valley reading follows the leaders (the ตะเฆ่ราง leader lands on the diagonal between the two masses, the ตะเฆ่สัน leaders on the corner diagonals). Verify against the elevations before relying on it., ONLY THE OVERSAILS ARE DIMENSIONED. Seven 1.20 figures fix the eaves: north of grid D, west of grid 1 (twice, once for each mass), east of grid 3, south of grid A, and the right-wing reference outline. NOTHING dimensions where the main mass ends and the wing begins, so both roof_area extents carry extent_partly_scaled., The right-wing roof from S-05 is repeated on this sheet in thin dashed outline as reference only., The main-block roof COVERING is framed here, but S-05 also draws a BS1 grillage over the same area at what appears to be a lower level. The two are complementary, not alternatives: S-05 is the beam/post layer that the S-06 rafters and purlins sit on. The ขยาย "1" detail on S-15 shows exactly that stack -- RC column, BS1 beam, จันทัน rafter., VERIFIED LATER AGAINST A-07 (PNG 09). The architectural roof plan agrees with every point traced from line weights here -- main ridge about 0.50 m north of grid C, main mass grid 1-1.20 to grid 3+1.20, wing grid 1-1.20 to grid 2+1.20 with a letter-direction ridge at about x = 2.00, hips crossing at the mid-point. A-07 also supplies the pitch this sheet omits: SLOPE 25 degrees.

data.file_warnings: First of the pile-cap enlargement sheets. F1 (1 pile) and F3 (3 piles) -- confirming the F<n> = pile-count convention read off the S-02 plan., F1 AND F3 ARE BUILT VERY DIFFERENTLY, which is worth keeping straight: F1 is a deep 0.80 m block (0.50 above the pile head plus 0.30 of pile embedment) reinforced like a short column with 8 Ø16 verticals and 2-leg Ø9 ties at 0.10; F3 is a shallow 0.20 m mat with only 0.05 of pile embedment, reinforced with 3-Ø12 + 6-Ø9 top and bottom and a Ø9 perimeter binder., PILE-HEAD LEVEL DIFFERS between the two: -1.50 under F1 (1.00 + 0.50) and -1.20 under F3 (1.00 + 0.20). Both are computed from the printed chains, not printed as levels themselves -- only the ระดับหัวเสาเข็ม arrow is drawn., The F3 bottom-bar tags are printed twice with slightly different spacing ('3-Ø12 มม. +6-Ø9 มม.' vs '3-Ø12 มม.+ 6-Ø9 มม.'). Same bars, transcribed as printed in each position., The trailing ⌐ / ⌐-like glyph after the F1 4+4 Ø12 and both F3 bar tags is the standard hook symbol on these sheets. It is kept in printed_as rather than being turned into a bend length, which the sheet does not give., Both details defer the pier above to another sheet ('ตอม่อดูขยายเสา'), i.e. the column schedule on S-11 (PNG 44). No pier reinforcement is shown here., The remaining marks used on the S-02 plan -- F6, F8, F10, F12 and F16 -- must be on S-08 to S-10. The S-01 index calls the fourth of those sheets 'ขยายฐานรากเสาเข็ม F18', a mark that does not appear on the plan; that discrepancy is still open at this point in the set.

Its x chain is eight equal 0.35 steps because the two outer rows (three piles each, at 0.70 / 1.40 / 2.10) sit half a step off the middle row (four piles, at 0.35 / 1.05 / 1.75 / 2.45). F12 by contrast is a plain 4 x 3 grid at 0.70 m. Reading F10's chain as a 0.70 module would place its piles wrongly., Both caps are 0.35 m thick, continuing the pattern that thickness grows with pile count (F3 0.20, F6 0.25, F8 0.30, F10/F12 0.35). All other depth figures are unchanged: 1.00 to the cap top, 0.05 pile-head embedment, 0.30 pier, 0.10 lean projection, 0.08 lean concrete over 0.08 sand. Computed pile-head level is -1.30 on both., F16 -- the largest mark on the S-02 plan -- is still not detailed. It must be on S-10 (PNG 43), which the S-01 index calls 'ขยายฐานรากเสาเข็ม F18'. That naming conflict is resolved on the next sheet.

Three independent marks on the drawing against one in the title block, and F16 is also the mark actually used on the S-02 foundation plan -- so F18 is a title-block/index typo. element_id is F16; the printed F18 is preserved in this file's sheet_name and in the S-02 warning., Sixteen piles on a plain 4 x 4 grid at 0.70 m centres, and Ø16 top AND bottom (16-Ø16 each face) -- the heaviest reinforcement of any cap in the set. Computed pile-head level -1.30., THE PILE-CAP SERIES IS NOW COMPLETE: F1 (S-07), F3 (S-07), F6 (S-08), F8 (S-08), F10 (S-09), F12 (S-09), F16 (S-10). data.view_title: ตารางเสา  มาตราส่วน 1:20
data.file_warnings: COLUMN SCHEDULE. Rows are levels read bottom-up -- ระดับตอม่อ/ฐานราก, then พื้นชั้นที่ 1, then ระดับอะเส/พื้นชั้นที่ 2. An UP-ARROW in a cell means 'same as the storey below, continuing upward'; those cells are recorded with a continuation field and no section, rather than by silently copying the section down, so a consumer can tell a drawn section from an inherited one., *** THE C1 CELL AT อะเส LEVEL IS SPLIT IN TWO, and the two halves disagree on purpose: the left half is a DASH (the column stops -- the single-storey part of the house) and the right half is an UP-ARROW (the column continues to floor 2). No other cell in the table is split. Both halves are recorded as separate C1 entries at that level; treating C1 as one column at this level would lose the distinction. ***, SECTIONS SHRINK GOING UP while bar counts mostly do not: C2 goes 250 -> 200 keeping 4 Ø16, and C3 goes 300 -> 200 keeping all 8 Ø16 before dropping to 4 Ø16 above floor 2. The 200 x 200 C3 with eight Ø16 and a double tie is the most congested cage in the schedule., Tie shapes are drawn, not named: a plain square outline for the single-tie columns and a square-plus-diamond octagon for the '2ป.' columns. Recorded in Thai in stirrup.shape as ปลอกเดี่ยวสี่เหลี่ยม / ปลอกสี่เหลี่ยม + ปลอกทแยง (2 ปลอก)., C1 and CX use ป.Ø6@0.175 ม. -- an unusual 175 mm spacing that every other column on the sheet replaces with 0.20 ม., CX SITS OUTSIDE THE TABLE with no level assigned. It is the extra off-grid column seen on the S-03 floor plan at the head of the stair opening. Its section and steel are identical to C1 at pier level, so it is most likely a C1 by another name, but the sheet does not say so and no level row is given -- flagged rather than merged., The schedule covers C1, C2, C3 and CX. The steel posts CS1 (S-05) and CS2 (S-04) are NOT in this table -- they are sized in their own sheets' หมายเหตุ blocks as 2C sections.

data.view_title: ขยายคาน B1-B7 / RB1, GB1, GB1X  1:20
data.file_warnings: THE BEAM SCHEDULE FOR THE WHOLE HOUSE. Eleven marks: B1, B1A, B2, B2A, B2X, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, RB1, GB1, GB1X. Every beam mark used on the S-03 and S-04 framing plans is defined here., TWO MARKS ARE DRAWN AS FULL ELEVATIONS (B1,B1A and B2,B2A) and the rest only as cross-sections. The elevations carry bar-curtailment information the sections cannot: top bars run 1.25 m each side of the interior support and the extra bottom bars are cranked up 0.60 m from the support. Those figures are recorded under bar_cutoff_m on B1A and B2A., THE 'A' SUFFIX MEANS THE LONGER SPAN OF A CONTINUOUS PAIR, not a different section: B1 is the 4.00 m span and B1A the 5.00 m span of the same beam line, with the same 200x500 section and the same top steel but double the bottom steel (achieved with cranked bars, which is why section 1A-1A shows 4-Ø16 against the elevation's '2-Ø16 + 2-Ø16'). Same for B2 / B2A at 3 and 6 bars., B2X IS THE ONLY MARK WHOSE BARS ARE DECLARED AS RUN-THROUGH from another beam -- both its tags carry '(ต่อเนื่องจากคาน B2)'. It is the 1.20 m cantilever past grid 4 on S-03. The counts are recorded as printed, but a quantity take-off must not double-count them against B2., B5 IS THE OUTLIER: 3-Ø20 top and 5-Ø20 bottom with ป.Ø9 มม.@0.20 ม. Every other RC beam here uses Ø16 or Ø12 main bars with ป.Ø6 มม.@0.15 ม. B5 frames the stair well., DEPTHS IN USE: 700 (B7), 500 (B1/B1A/B2/B2A/B2X/B3/B5/GB1/GB1X), 400 (B4/B6/RB1). All beams are 200 mm wide without exception., GB1 and GB1X share one detail headed 'GB1, GB1X', so they are identical in section and reinforcement. What the X suffix distinguishes is not stated on this sheet., The elevation tags are written without a hyphen ('3Ø16 มม.') while the section tags use one ('3-Ø16 มม.'). Both are transcribed as printed in each place; they are the same bars., This sheet defines RC beams only. The steel beams BS1 (S-05) and the steel roof members are sized in their own sheets' หมายเหตุ blocks and appear nowhere here.

data.file_warnings: *** NO TREAD OR RISER DIMENSION IS GIVEN ON THIS SHEET. *** Every step dimension is replaced by the note 'ระยะลูกนอนตามแบบสถาปัตยกรรม' / 'ระยะลูกตั้งตามแบบสถาปัตยกรรม' -- go to the architectural drawings (A-01..A-31) for them. tread_m and riser_m are therefore null with the deferral recorded verbatim, not guessed at. The same applies to one bar tag, 'Ø9 มม.@ตามแบบ', whose spacing is set out to match the step layout., ST-1 IS DRAWN AS TWO SEPARATE FLIGHT DETAILS but only the lower one carries the title 'ขยายบันได ST-1'. The upper detail at the top of the sheet is the same stair's other flight -- both share the 0.15 waist, the same bar set, the B6 landing beam and the 1.00 m lap. They are recorded as two section_views of one ST-1 element rather than as two stairs., THE TWO STAIRS ARE REINFORCED QUITE DIFFERENTLY: ST-1 uses Ø12@0.20 main bars (tightening to Ø12@0.10 across the landing) on a 0.15 waist; ST2 uses only Ø9@0.20 on a 0.10 waist. Do not carry ST-1's bar schedule across to ST2., Landing support differs too: ST-1 lands on the RC beam B6 ('B6,คานชานพัก'), ST2 spans between two B2X beams. Both beam marks are defined on S-12., '1Ø9 มม.ทุกมุม' -- one Ø9 bar at EVERY step corner -- appears on both stairs. The number of corners is not stated, so no total count can be derived from this sheet alone; it depends on the step count in the architectural drawings., The sheet's own title block says 'ขยายบันได ST-1, ST-2' with a hyphen, while the drawing titles read 'ขยายบันได ST-1' and 'ขยายบันได ST2' (no hyphen on the second). The plans on S-03/S-04 also use ST1 and ST2 without hyphens. Recorded as printed in each place; they are the same two stairs., RESOLVED BY A-16 (PNG 18). The architectural stair enlargement gives what this sheet deferred: ST-1 has 10 ลูกตั้ง @0.15 and 9 ลูกนอน @0.275 per flight, two flights, 20 risers, 3.00 m total rise, 0.90 m flight width in a 2.40 m well, 1.30 m landing. ST-2 is on A-18.

data.view_title: ขยาย DETAIL 1, 2, 3 / ขยาย "1"  1:10
data.file_warnings: *** THIS SHEET RESOLVES THE UNRESOLVED CROSS-REFERENCES FROM S-04 AND S-05. *** S-04 carries six circled callouts (DETAIL 1 x4 at B-2/A-2/C-3/B-3, DETAIL 2 at C-4, DETAIL 3 at B-4) and S-05 one (ดูขยาย "1" at A-1), none of which said where the enlargement lived. All four are drawn here., DETAILS 1, 2 AND 3 ARE THE SAME JOINT FAMILY -- a C-150x75x9.0x12.5 channel welded all round to a steel plate that is bolted to RC with four Ø16 bolts drilled 0.30 m into the column. What changes is the plate and the host: DETAIL 1 lands between two RC BEAMS on a 300x200x12 plate, DETAIL 2 on an RC COLUMN on the same 300x200x12 plate, DETAIL 3 on a column with a square 200x200x12 plate on a 0.20 x 0.20 section., NOTE THE CHANNEL SIZE CLASH BETWEEN SHEETS. The channel in DETAILS 1-3 is C-150x75x9.0x12.5 -- the S-04 terrace rafter section (24 กก./ม.). But the ขยาย "1" detail on this same sheet uses C-150x75x25x3.2 (8.27 กก./ม.) for both the rafter and BS1, matching S-05. Two different 150x75 channels are in use across the set; they differ in thickness by a factor of three. Always take the section from the sheet that details the member in question., 'ล้วงลึกลงเสายาว 0.30 ม.' on the bolt tag means the bolts are drilled and set 0.30 m INTO the RC column, not that they are 0.30 m long overall. Recorded as embedment_m rather than length., ขยาย "1" is the only detail on the sheet with anchor bars rather than bolts: two Ø9 loops 0.15 m into the column head under a 200x200x9 base plate., All four details are at 1:10 -- the largest scale used anywhere in the structural set.

data.file_warnings: FIVE JOINT DETAILS for the precast SOLID PLANK (SP) floor system that S-03 and S-04 tag across most of the framed floors, plus one detail for the cast-in-place S slab. This is the sheet that says HOW the SP planks land., THE GOVERNING RULE IS THE BEARING MINIMUM: 'ระยะไม่น้อยกว่า 0.05 ม.' -- each plank end must seat at least 50 mm on its support. It is printed three times on the first detail and once on each of the next two. It is a MINIMUM, not a set-out dimension, and is recorded as bearing.min_m., TOPPING IS 0.05 M EVERYWHERE on this sheet, matching S-01 item 4 (SOLID PLANK 5 cm + 5 cm topping)., EXTRA TOPPING STEEL ('เสริมพิเศษ') RUNS 0.70 M EACH SIDE of a plank joint, at Ø6@0.20. Where the joint is with a cast-in-place S slab or a bathroom step the tie bars step up from 1+1Ø6 to 1+1Ø9 and the S slab's own Ø9@0.20 continues through., BEAM DEPTH AT THE JOINT VARIES BY CASE: 0.30 m for the plain interior joint, 0.40 m for the S-slab, bathroom and raised-slab cases. The details are drawn for a given depth, so pairing the wrong detail with a beam mark from S-12 will give the wrong bar lengths., THE BATHROOM DETAIL IS THE ONLY ONE WITH A LEVEL CHANGE: 0.10 m down to ระดับพื้นห้องน้ำ. Nothing else distinguishes it from the SP-to-S detail., The edge-beam detail ('บริเวณริมคาน') is tagged with the TOPPING and 0.05 only -- no bearing figure, no reinforcement, no beam depth. Flagged no_reinforcement_tagged rather than filled in from the neighbouring details.

data.file_warnings: LAST SHEET OF THE STRUCTURAL SET (S-17 of 17). It continues S-16 with six more SP plank details, and carries the same title block text as S-16 -- the two sheets are only distinguishable by their sheet code and their contents., *** ONE DETAIL CHANGES THE BEARING RULE. *** 'บริเวณรอยตัดขาดหรือริม' states the minimum seating as 'ระยะไม่น้อยกว่า 1/2 ความกว้างคาน' -- half the beam width -- instead of the flat 'ไม่น้อยกว่า 0.05 ม.' used everywhere else. On a 0.20 m beam that is 0.10 m, double the general minimum. Recorded as a rule, not as a number, since it depends on the beam., TWO DETAILS COVER PLANKS WITH NO BEAM UNDER THEM ('เสาหรือคานที่ไม่มีที่รองรับ'), and they are different solutions, not variants: one cantilevers a short cast-in-place nib off the column with 2Ø12 anchored in ('ฝังเข้าเสา') and a printed limit of ไม่เกิน 0.60 ม.; the other uses a diagonal haunch with 2Ø9. Both share the same title, so they must be told apart by their geometry., 'ขยายยกขอบคาน' GIVES NO HEIGHT -- only the 0.10 m thickness and one Ø9 bar, with the height deferred as 'ระยะตามแบบสถาปัตย์'. Flagged height_deferred_to_architectural rather than scaled off the drawing., The level-change detail ('บริเวณต่างระดับ') likewise does not dimension the step between the two SP floors; flagged step_height_not_dimensioned., Tie-bar size tracks the beam depth across both sheets: 1+1Ø6 on the 0.30 m beams, 1+1Ø9 on the 0.40 m beams. The เสริมพิเศษ topping mesh stays Ø6@0.20 running 0.70 m each side of a joint throughout.

data.file_warnings: *** A THIRD DRAWING NUMBER APPEARS IN THIS SET: SN 62034. *** The structural sheets are S 62047, the architectural AR 61142, and the sanitary SN 62034 -- three separately numbered submissions for one house, all dated ม.ค. 2562. The drawing number is a submission id, never a project id., Ten sanitary sheets, SN-01 to SN-10, mapping to PNG 51-60 on the same +2 offset as the rest of the book., THE PIPE TABLE IS THE MOST QUANTIFIABLE THING HERE and it carries the falls, which no plan repeats: soil (S) at 1:100, waste (W), kitchen waste (K) and rainwater all at 1:50, vent (V) and cold water (CW) with no fall stated., PIPE CLASS SPLITS BY SERVICE, and getting it wrong is a real error: everything DRAINING is PVC class 8.5, but the potable cold-water line CW is class 13.5 -- the heavier wall. Both to มอก.17. External storm drainage is not PVC at all, it is off-the-shelf concrete pipe ('ท่อคอนกรีตท้องตลาด') sized 'ตามแบบ'., The legend runs to about 40 symbols in four columns. Two pairs share one abbreviation with different drawn symbols -- FD. (two floor-drain types), FCO. (two floor cleanout types) and AVC. (top-vent and side-vent caps) -- so the abbreviation alone does not identify the item; the drawn symbol does., ONE ITEM IN THE LEGEND IS NOT PLUMBING AT ALL: DC, a dry-chemical ABC fire extinguisher, 6A-20B 15 lbs to มอก.332. It is a real countable item that appears in no architectural schedule., SW ('ท่อระบายน้ำเสียรวม') and R ('ท่อระบายน้ำฝน') are in the legend but NOT in the pipe-type table, so they have no class or fall specified on this sheet.

data.file_warnings: Sanitary specification, sheet 1 of 2 (continues on SN-03). Three numbered sections: general requirements, pipes and valves, and installation., TWO HARD NUMBERS WORTH PULLING OUT, both under section 2: every GATE/BALL valve and every CHECK VALVE on the potable system must be rated 50% above working pressure AND not less than **Class 125**; and a **STOP VALVE is required at every fixture branch** -- cistern WC, basin, bidet spray and sink. The A-29 สุขภัณฑ์ note says the same thing from the architectural side, so the two disciplines agree., The warranty is stated here and nowhere else: **2 years from final handover**, covering machinery and equipment., THE CONTRACTOR CARRIES THE EXTERNAL CONNECTIONS AT HIS OWN COST -- both the incoming water main plus the water meter (excluding any supply-area extension) and the outfall connection to the public drain including any permit fee. That is real money and it is stated only in 1.8., Clause 1.2 declares the whole drawing set advisory ('แบบและรายการที่แสดงไว้ เป็นเพียงแนวทางเท่านั้น') -- an alternative method may be proposed but needs written approval first., Clause 1.4 obliges the contractor to supply and fit any fitting needed for correct work EVEN IF NOT DRAWN, at no extra charge. Anything a take-off misses from the drawings is therefore still the contractor's risk., 5 sets of AS-BUILT drawings are required before the final payment (1.6.2).

data.file_warnings: Sanitary specification sheet 2 of 2, continuing SN-02's section 3 and adding external drainage (4) and testing (5)., *** ONE ABSOLUTE PROHIBITION: 'ห้ามใช้ข้อต่อสามทางฉากโดยเด็ดขาด' -- a square/90-degree tee may NEVER be used on soil or waste pipe; only Y-tees or TY-tees. *** It uses เด็ดขาด, the strongest wording on the sheet, and it is a rule an installer can easily breach with a standard fitting., THE TESTING CLAUSE IS THE MOST QUANTIFIED PART OF THE WHOLE SANITARY SET and appears nowhere else: potable system at not less than **75 psi held 2 hours** with no pressure drop; drainage under a **3 m water head held 2 hours**; and tank disinfection with **10% chlorine at 50 cc per m³, soaked overnight** then flushed., TRENCHING IS SPECIFIED WITH REAL NUMBERS TOO: dig not less than **10 cm below the pipe invert**, tamp and grade the bottom to the pipe's fall, and bed on water-compacted sand. Backfill may only be the excavated soil or sand -- stone, brick or anything similar is forbidden., Pipes may only be laid dry (4.3.1) -- the contractor must keep the trench dewatered at his own cost until the concrete has set, and must pipe the pumped water away without nuisance., Reinstatement is the contractor's (4.4.5): road surface, power poles, cables, water main, footpath -- all to be restored exactly as found., Hangers and supports may be proprietary but need the supervisor's approval before use (3.2); underground valves must have the stem above ground or sit in a VALVE BOX (3.1.7).

data.file_warnings: *** THREE NUMERIC TABLES THAT TOGETHER SIZE EVERY PIPE SUPPORT IN THE BUILDING: hanger spacing (12 pipe sizes x 7 materials x vertical/horizontal), clamp flat-bar size by pipe size, and hanger-rod diameter by pipe size. *** They are the only place any of this is specified., FOR THIS HOUSE ONLY THE PVC COLUMN APPLIES (SN-01 makes every pipe PVC except the external concrete storm drain). The numbers that matter: ø2" PVC at 1.8 m vertical / 1.5 m horizontal, ø4" at 2.4 m both ways, with ø9 mm hanger rods up to 1 1/2" and ø12 mm from 2" to 3"., THE SPACING TABLE CANNOT BE READ ON ITS OWN. The cast-iron and copper columns contain cross-references ('ดูท้ายตาราง 2', '3', '4') instead of numbers, which resolve to the notes at the bottom: every storey and every joint (2), every 1.0 m and every joint (3), every 1.2 m and every joint (4). The table and its notes must travel together., Note 1 is the governing rule regardless of spacing: EVERY length of pipe must have at least one support., The under-slab detail requires MORE THAN 0.60 m of cover to ground, which is the same figure as the 'จุดต้นท่อลึก 0.60 ม' start-of-run marks on SN-04., A FLEXIBLE CONNECTION is required where pipe passes from a ground-bearing slab into the ground -- the settlement joint. Easy to miss in a take-off and it is a specific fitting., The table is dense and was transcribed cell by cell; flagged dense_numeric_table so a reviewer knows to spot-check it against the image rather than trust it blind., One note under the hanging details is partly illegible at this scan resolution and is transcribed as read, flagged text_partly_illegible.

data.file_warnings: Last sanitary sheet (SN-10 of 10). It is the enlargement SN-04's channel callout points to ('รางระบายน้ำ คสล กว้าง 0.30ม ... ดูแบบขยาย') -- that cross-reference resolves., *** TWO ALTERNATIVE COVERS ARE DETAILED AT THE SAME 0.39 x 0.50 x 0.075 SIZE: a steel grating and an RC slab. *** The sheet does not say which goes where, and SN-04's plan callout says only 'ฝาปิด คสล'. On that evidence the RC cover is the one used and the steel grating is an alternative -- but nothing states it, so both are recorded and neither is dropped., THE CHANNEL SECTION IS FULLY SPECIFIED and is a real concrete quantity that the plans only hint at: 0.30 m clear width, 0.05 m walls, 0.39 m cover width, 0.10 m base slab over 0.10 m of water-compacted coarse sand, rendered smooth inside, reinforced Ø9@0.20 with Ø6 at not more than 0.20 and 3-Ø6 in the base., CHANNEL DEPTH IS NOT A FIXED FIGURE -- it is marked 'ลึกตามแบบ / ตามระดับความลาด', i.e. set by the 1:200 fall from SN-04. Depth therefore varies along the run and cannot be taken as a single number., The steel grating is 6x50 mm flat bars at 40 mm centres in a 6x75 mm frame -- countable if that option is taken.

data.file_warnings: *** A FOURTH DRAWING NUMBER: EE 62062. *** The set now has S 62047 (structural), AR 61142 (architectural), SN 62034 (sanitary) and EE 62062 (electrical) -- four separately numbered submissions for one house, all ม.ค. 2562., *** THE SYMBOL TABLE CARRIES A MOUNTING HEIGHT FOR ALMOST EVERY DEVICE, and those heights are the A-03 accessibility brief made real: switches at 0.90 m (A-03 requires not more than 0.90), sockets at 0.45 m (A-03 requires at least 0.45), RJ45 outlets also at 0.45, TV outlet at 0.90. *** The electrical engineer clearly worked to the same brief., Two heights DEPART from that pattern for good reason: the weatherproof WP socket sits at 1.30 m (outdoors, above splash) and the daylight switch at 2.50 m. Neither is a circulation device., LUMINAIRES ARE SPECIFIED BY PERFORMANCE, NOT MODEL: batten LED T8 not more than 20 W, COOL WHITE, at least 1,600 lm and at least 25,000 h life; downlight 100-125 mm, E27 LED not more than 7 W, WARM WHITE, at least 600 lm; wall light the same lamp in a UV-resistant aluminium weatherproof body. Every figure is a MINIMUM or a MAXIMUM, never a target., COLOUR TEMPERATURE IS DELIBERATELY SPLIT: COOL WHITE for the batten fittings, WARM WHITE for the downlights and wall lights., BOTH CIRCUIT TYPES USE THE SAME CABLE AND CONDUIT -- IEC 01 2.5 sq.mm in ø15 mm PVC for lighting AND for sockets. There is no lighter lighting circuit, which simplifies the take-off considerably., The ground rod is fully specified and countable: copper-bond or copper-clad steel to UL, ø14.20 mm x 2.40 m, top buried about 0.30 m below ground., *** ONE ITEM IS EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE: the RB router position is 'โดยผู้ให้บริการ INTERNET ไม่รวมในงานนี้' -- the position is drawn but the equipment is the ISP's, not the contractor's. *** Do not price it., JWH (water-heater connection box) appears in the legend, so a water heater is anticipated even though A-29's สุขภัณฑ์ list schedules no heater and SN-08's basin detail calls hot water '(ถ้ามี)'., Eleven approved-brand lists are given, four of them tied to a มอก. number: conduit มอก.216-2524, cable มอก.11-2553, switches มอก.824-2531, sockets มอก.116-2549.

data.view_title: ไดอะแกรมระบบไฟฟ้า (single-line diagram)
data.file_warnings: The whole electrical installation on one single-line diagram: a 15(45) A single-phase service, about 20 m of buried 2-1/C-10 NYY in ø32 HDPE, a 50 A 2-pole main at 10 kA, and a 14-way consumer unit., *** CIRCUIT ALLOCATION: 2 lighting (F1-F2), 3 socket (F3-F5), 2 water heater (F6-F7), 5 air-conditioning (F8-F12), 2 SPACE. *** Twelve of fourteen ways used., *** RCBO WITH 30 mA RESIDUAL PROTECTION ON EVERY SOCKET AND WATER-HEATER CIRCUIT (F3-F7), BUT PLAIN MCBs ON THE LIGHTING (F1-F2). *** That is a deliberate and correct distinction, and it is a price difference of five devices that a take-off reading only 'breaker' will miss., Water heaters get 20 AT where sockets get 16 AT, on the same 2.5 sq.mm cable., *** FIVE AIR-CONDITIONING WAYS ARE MARKED 'BY ME' AND CARRY NEITHER A BREAKER RATING NOR A CABLE SIZE ON THIS SHEET -- RESOLVED BY M-01 (PNG 67). *** The mechanical schedule supplies both and the unit count matches exactly five: 2 cassette units in ห้องพักผ่อน/ทานอาหาร at 24,000 BTU/Hr and wall units in ห้องนอน 1, 2 and 3. Breakers are 25AT-1P with 2-4 mm2 + G-2.5 for the 24,000 units and 20AT-1P with 2-2.5 + G-2.5 for the 18,000 units, all at 220/1/50., TWO WATER-HEATER CIRCUITS CONFIRM THE JWH SYMBOL from EE-01 -- so two heaters are anticipated, one per bathroom. Note this sits against A-29's สุขภัณฑ์ list, which schedules NO water heater at all, and SN-08's basin detail, which calls hot water '(ถ้ามี)'. The electrical set provides for it; the architectural and sanitary sets do not supply it., EVERY SPECIFIED FINAL CIRCUIT USES THE SAME CABLE -- 2-2.5/G2.5 IEC 01 in ø15 mm PVC -- exactly as EE-01's wiring spec states. There is no lighter lighting circuit anywhere., The earth conductor is 10 sq.mm, four times any final-circuit conductor, to a ø14.20 x 2.4 m copper rod buried 0.30 m -- matching EE-01's legend., M-01 also explains why this 14-way board has NO exhaust-fan circuit: the seven exhaust fans are fed from the room LIGHTING circuits, not from a dedicated way. Lighting ways F1 and F2 therefore carry more than the lighting plans alone show.

data.file_warnings: *** A FIFTH DRAWING NUMBER: M 62028. *** The set is S 62047 (structural), AR 61142 (architectural), SN 62034 (sanitary), EE 62062 (electrical) and M 62028 (mechanical) -- five separately numbered submissions, all ม.ค. 2562., *** THIS SHEET CLOSES THE 'BY ME' GAP LEFT OPEN BY EE-02. *** EE-02 showed five air-conditioning ways F8-F12 with a bracket marked 'BY ME' and no breaker rating or cable size. The schedule here supplies both, and the unit count matches EXACTLY: 2 cassettes in ห้องพักผ่อน/ทานอาหาร plus wall units in ห้องนอน 1, 2 and 3 = five units, five ways., THE BREAKERS THE ELECTRICAL SET OMITTED ARE HERE: 25 AT 1-pole with 2-4 mm² + G-2.5 for the 24,000 BTU/Hr units, 20 AT 1-pole with 2-2.5 mm² + G-2.5 for the 18,000 BTU/Hr units, all in ø1/2" conduit at 220/1/50. Note the 4 mm² conductor -- heavier than the 2.5 mm² used on every other circuit in the house., *** THE EXHAUST FANS HAVE NO DEDICATED CIRCUIT AT ALL: they are fed from the room LIGHTING circuit ('มาจากวงจรไฟฟ้าแสงสว่างประจำห้อง'). *** That explains why EE-02's 14-way board has no fan way. It also means the lighting circuits F1/F2 carry more load than the lighting plans alone suggest., A CONDUIT DISCREPANCY BETWEEN DISCIPLINES: the fan note here specifies ø1/2" EMT (steel), while EE-01 and EE-02 specify ø15 mm PVC throughout. Recorded as printed on each sheet; not reconciled by either., COOLING TOTAL IS 108,000 BTU/Hr over five units (2 x 24,000 + 18,000 + 18,000 + 24,000). Only four rooms are air-conditioned -- the living/dining space and the three bedrooms. Kitchen, bathrooms, laundry and car port are not., SEVEN EXHAUST FANS IN FOUR TYPES: one 520 CFM wall propeller (EF-1) and six ceiling fans (3 x 50, 1 x 80, 2 x 230 CFM). Positions are on M-02 and M-03., EER IS A HARD REQUIREMENT: at least 11.60 for units up to 27,296 BTU/Hr, or a No. 5 energy label. Every unit in this house is 24,000 BTU/Hr or less, so the 11.60 tier applies throughout., The mark format is decoded on the sheet itself: CU/FC + floor + running number, e.g. FCW-2/01 = wall fan coil, floor 2, unit 01.

Three fan coils (two 24,000 BTU/Hr cassettes over the living/dining space and one 18,000 BTU/Hr wall unit in ห้องนอน 1) with their three condensing units, plus four exhaust fans., *** THE CONDENSING UNITS ARE ALL ON EXTERNAL WALLS AND TWO OF THEM STACK: CU-1/01 above CU-1/02 on the west wall, CU-1/03 on the north wall. *** M-01 note 4 requires a steel frame and vibration pads under every one, and M-04 details it at 15 cm high on angle steel with 1" isolators -- a real item that no structural or architectural sheet shows., DUCT SIZES ARE TAGGED ON THE PLAN AND ONLY HERE: EAG 6"x4" with ø6" insulated flex for the 50 CFM fan, 6"x6"/ø6" for the 80 CFM, 10"x8"/ø10" for the 230 CFM. M-01's fan schedule gives capacity but no duct., The 520 CFM EF-1 propeller fan is in the KITCHEN and is the only wall-mounted fan in the house -- ten times the capacity of the bathroom fans., 'CU By.EE' on this plan and 'BY ME' on EE-02 are the two halves of the same handover: the mechanical engineer sizes the equipment and its breaker, the electrical engineer provides the board. Read together the arrangement is complete; read separately each sheet looks incomplete., Cassette units are drawn in the CEILING of the living and dining areas, which matters against A-12's 2.50 m ground-floor ceiling -- a cassette needs plenum depth above it that the architectural section does not show.

data.file_warnings: Second-floor HVAC plan: two wall fan coils (18,000 in ห้องนอน 2, 24,000 in ห้องนอน 3) with their condensing units, plus three exhaust fans., *** THE FAN COUNTS NOW RECONCILE EXACTLY WITH M-01's SCHEDULE ACROSS THE TWO PLANS: CEF-1 x3 (one on M-02, two here), CEF-2 x1 (M-02), CEF-3 x2 (one each sheet), EF-1 x1 (M-02). *** Seven fans, and every scheduled quantity is accounted for on a plan. That is a clean cross-check and it is worth noting because the electrical set has no fan schedule at all., The five fan coils likewise reconcile: FCS-1/01, FCS-1/02, FCW-1/03 on M-02 and FCW-2/01, FCW-2/02 here -- five units, matching M-01's schedule and EE-02's five 'BY ME' ways., *** CU-2/01 SITS ON THE SINGLE-STOREY WING'S ROOF. *** Its M-04 steel support frame therefore lands on the steel roof structure framed by S-05, which no structural sheet allows for. Worth flagging to the structural engineer -- a condensing unit plus frame is a point load on purlins sized for roof sheeting., *** ห้องนอน 3 GETS A LARGER UNIT (24,000) THAN ห้องนอน 2 (18,000) even though A-31's furniture layout gives ห้องนอน 2 the double bed. *** The two sheets rank the bedrooms differently; neither is wrong, but a reviewer should know they disagree on which room is the main one., Duct sizes are again tagged on the plan only.

This particular sheet's rows were NOT re-read from its own PNG; they were carried across from the verified-identical ฐานรากแผ่ counterpart named in derived_from. Anyone using this file for anything quantity-critical should re-read its own PNG first., PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json., EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. That is a clean confirmation of both plan readings., Every description runs onto a second line with no quantity of its own; those are kept as separate items per spec §11 rather than being folded into the row above.

data.file_warnings: *** EXTRACTION METHOD FOR THIS SHEET -- READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING IT. *** The two BOQ sets in this book (ฐานรากแผ่ at PNG 71-87 and ฐานรากเข็มตอก at PNG 88-104) are the SAME 34-sheet ปร.4 template issued twice, differing only in (a) the foundation name in the title line and (b) the foundation item inside หมวดงานโครงสร้าง. The page mapping is exact and one-to-one: set-2 PNG = set-1 PNG + 17, same physical half, same แผ่นที่ n/34. That mapping and the line-for-line identity of the non-structural categories were VERIFIED VISUALLY at ten points spanning the whole range: 88_1 (1/34), 88_2 (2/34), 89_1 (3/34), 89_2 (4/34), 90_1 (5/34), 90_2 (6/34), 91_1 (7/34), 95_2 (16/34), 99_1 (23/34), 104_2 (34/34). This particular sheet's rows were NOT re-read from its own PNG; they were carried across from the verified-identical ฐานรากแผ่ counterpart named in derived_from. Anyone using this file for anything quantity-critical should re-read its own PNG first., PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json., EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented., The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank., *** THE BREAKER COUNT RECONCILES WITH EE-02 EXACTLY, AND IT PROVES THE 'BY ME' READING WAS RIGHT. *** The BOQ prices 1 x 14-way board with a 50AT-2P 10kA main, 2 x 20AT-1P RCBO, 3 x 16AT-1P RCBO and 2 x 16AT-1P plain -- which is EE-02's F1 and F2 (plain, lighting), F3/F4/F5 (RCBO, sockets) and F6/F7 (20AT RCBO, water heaters). SEVEN breakers, exactly the seven ways EE-02 specifies. The five air-conditioning ways are NOT here because they are priced in the mechanical category, precisely as the 'BY ME' bracket says., *** THE EARTH ROD COUNT IS 2, WHERE EE-01 AND EE-02 BOTH SHOW ONLY ONE. *** The specification (ø14.20 mm x 2.4 m copper bond, buried 0.30 m) matches both drawings word for word, but the quantity does not. Flagged; the BOQ is the quantity authority., EXOTHERMIC WELDING appears here and NOWHERE in the electrical drawings -- the cad-weld connection between the earth conductor and the rod. A real item that a take-off from EE-01/EE-02 alone would miss., *** THE CONDUIT QUANTITIES ARE THE HEADLINE FIGURES: 423 m of ø15 mm PVC and 22 m of ø32 mm HDPE. *** The HDPE matches EE-02's buried service run ('ประมาณ 20 เมตร') with 2 m to spare. The 423 m of PVC is the whole building's wiring, a number no drawing gives., Both conduit sizes and materials match EE-01's wiring specification exactly -- ø15 PVC for all final circuits, HDPE PN6 ø32 for the incoming service.

This particular sheet's rows were NOT re-read from its own PNG; they were carried across from the verified-identical ฐานรากแผ่ counterpart named in derived_from. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json., EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented., The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank., *** THIS IS THE LUMINAIRE SCHEDULE THE ELECTRICAL DRAWINGS NEVER PROVIDE: 7 batten fittings, 33 downlights and 8 wall lights, 48 luminaires in all. *** EE-03 and EE-04 draw the positions but carry no schedule, so the counts on those two files were read off the symbols and flagged count_read_from_symbols. These are the authoritative numbers., The luminaire descriptions are copied from EE-01's legend almost verbatim, including the performance minima -- 1,600 lm and 25,000 h for the battens, 600 lm for the E27 lamps, COOL WHITE against WARM WHITE., *** ONE FIGURE DISAGREES: the BOQ says the batten lamp is 'ไม่เกิน 1-10W' where EE-01 says 'ไม่เกิน 1-20 วัตต์'. *** A 1,600 lm LED T8 is more consistent with 20 W than 10 W, so EE-01 is the likelier correct value -- but neither is corrected. The two figures are consistent once the core count is applied -- a good cross-check., IEC01 10 sq.mm at 2 m is the earth conductor from the board to the rod, matching EE-02's '1-10 IEC 01 in ø15 มม.
